facts.fact: 圣诞老人买雪橇花了多少钱？没花钱：on the house 既指“免费”又指“在屋顶上”，雪橇正停在屋顶
facts.anchor: How much did Santa pay for his sleigh? Nothing, it was on the house.

facts.fact: 有六块腹肌的雪人叫 abdominal snowman——abdominal 谐音 abominable（雪人＝abominable snowman）
facts.anchor: What do you call a snowman with a six pack? An abdominal snowman!

facts.fact: 朋友送来德国圣诞果脯面包，我问 Is this stollen？（是偷来的吗）她答“不是，我自己做的”——stollen 与 stolen 同音
facts.anchor: I said, ‘Is this stollen?’ She said ‘No, I made it.’

facts.fact: 以为对方是雪橇广告模特：说 I think you’ve been misled（你被误导了），我听成 Miss Sled（雪橇小姐）
facts.anchor: She said, ‘I think you’ve been misled.’ I said, ‘Oh, I thought you’d been Miss Sled.’

facts.fact: 三博士逐个谐音：金＝gold guy、乳香＝frankincense fellow、没药＝myrrh man，三句都以“我是 X 人”收尾
facts.anchor: I said to the first one, ‘Wow, you’re dressed so ostentatiously, covered in precious metals!’ He said, ‘Yeah, I’m a gold guy.’

facts.fact: 收到的礼物完全不像芳香常绿香草：no thyme like the present——thyme（百里香）谐音 time，no time like the present（机不可失）
facts.anchor: There’s no thyme like the present.

facts.fact: 买错圣诞日历：本该是 advent calendar（有门的日历），买成 advent colander（碗状滤盆，满是孔）——两词形近
facts.anchor: Silly me, I’d accidentally bought an advent colander.

facts.fact: 圣诞老人的助手为什么害羞？low elf-esteem——self-esteem（自尊）换成 elf-esteem
facts.anchor: Why was Santa’s assistant so shy? He had low elf-esteem.

facts.fact: 斯克鲁奇怎么进的球？The Ghost of Christmas passed——past（过去之灵）换成 passed（传球）
facts.anchor: How did Ebeneezer Scrooge score a goal? The Ghost of Christmas passed.

facts.fact: 我说滑雪橇时听七十年代华丽摇滚乐队的圣诞歌，对方猜 Slade（乐队名），我改口把 sledded 说成 sleighed——Slade 与 sleighed 同音
facts.anchor: ‘Slade?’ ‘Okay fine, I sleighed down a hill listening to my favourite Christmas song by seventies glam rock band, Wizzard!’
